full_page.content:
Page 2A Cont.
Wm. Sadouceur - 47 - barber - sickly Doctors rather baffled - has wife and 8 ch. - finds it hard be struggle on
Mary Ruth Scanlon - 5 - bright little girl very lively till a fall last May. . . has been invalid ever since - can not stand or sit alone.
Page 3
Mary Drzuiacki - 24 - lent $150.00 when in trouble - now refuses to pay back .. ....
Nov. 1st Mrs. Matilda Van Walleghen - 41 - intestinal trouble; fears cancer; Expects operation Wednesday a.m. Next
Alice J. Ziolo - 7 - of Buffalo N. Y. - Spinal Maningits - big girl for 9. Had spinal Maningits when about 7 months old and never got well. Bright and much alert but extremely nerveous. Her parents drove down from Buffalo arriving at St. Bonaventure's at about 8 P.M. is starting back To-night ....
John Kester - 41 - Lutherin - serious stomach trouble feared
Page 4
Mrs. Alfred Jones - 50 - non Cath. invalid several -
Jerome Roberge - 8 - broken thigh - fears 3 rd operation, is enrolled to-night as perpetual member
Mary Medzger - 59 - broken arm since 21 August .... very slow in get- ting well.
Wm. Clark - non Cath. - 51 - in Ford Hosp ... cancer of throat. . .. Edw'd Hssessor - 18 - wayword disobedient .... stays out late. . . 9th Frank Vercammen - 26 - threatened with T.B. while keeping company. Was found to have it from a cold after marriage was announced ... Married and shortly after went to san. (Kiefer) got flue was thought to be hopeless ..... Enrolled perpetually in Ser. Mass Ass'n - is O.K. since.
9th Stuart Houstan - 23 - Asthma - was Carmelite Novice - had to leave when about to join advised .... Parents against his being Catholic has found it difficult to struggle on. .
